test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Arvind bought eight washing machines at Rs. 16,000 each and sold all of them at a total price of Rs. 1,12,640. Find his profit or loss percentage.
solution:
**Given:**

CP of eight washing machines = Rs. 16,000 each

SP of eight washing machine = Rs. 1,12,640

**Formula used:**

Loss = CP – SP

Loss% = Loss/CP × 100

**Calculation:**

CP of eight washing machines = Rs. (16,000 × 8)

⇒ 128,000

SP of eight washing machine = Rs. 1,12,640

Loss = CP – SP

⇒ Rs. (128,000 – 112,640)

⇒ Rs. 15,360

Loss% = Loss/CP × 100

⇒ (15,360/128,000 × 100)

⇒ (15,360/1280)

⇒ 12%

**∴ The required loss% is 12%**
